rules: Use aggressive negative letter-spacing (tracking-tighter) for all Unbounded headings.
Use JetBrains Mono for form inputs, token metrics, and technical data.
Never center-align headings unless it's explicitly for the hero text overlay.
Maintain a strict monochromatic structural discipline. Deep black backgrounds, stark white text.
Use the Electric Amber/Orange (#FF5500) strictly for primary conversion actions (Wallet Connect, Next/Deploy buttons) and active states.
Avoid 'crypto-blue' entirely. Stick to the aggressive space/rocket theme.

surfaces: No full-screen gradients. Use deep space black (#050505) with 1px subtle borders (#1A1A1A).
For sticky headers, use heavy glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/70 with a 1px border-b border-white/5.
Add subtle noise/grain texture overlays to the body background to kill digital flatness.
buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md) for form elements and utility actions.
Primary button hover: slight scale (scale-105), brighter orange, and subtle amber drop shadow.

layouts.grids: Use aggressive asymmetry. Utilize CSS Grid for the Token Creator form (bento box style: overlapping panels, sharp 1px borders).
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8 to p-12 inside containers. Ensure sections have massive padding (py-24 to py-32) to separate content.
layouts.hero: Massive typography overlaying a dark cinematic background. Text should take up 80% of the viewport width.

motion.scroll: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling to give the site premium momentum.
animations: Hero text: Framer Motion staggered line-by-line reveal on load.
Form entrance: Subtly slide up and fade in.
Marquee: Slow, continuous horizontal scroll for the 'How-to-use' or 'CoinLaunch features' ribbon.
motion.interactions: Micro-animations on every hover. Wallet connect button should have a magnetic or glowing hover state.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for body text against #050505. Use #FFFFFF for primary text, #A1A1AA for readable secondary text.
accessibility.focus: All form inputs must have a bright #FF5500 1px ring on focus focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF5500] focus:border-[#FF5500] outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, accordions) MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case-role.

components.fee_banner: Fixed at top. bg-[#FF5500] text-black font-bold text-xs uppercase tracking-widest py-2 px-4 flex justify-center items-center z-50.
components.header: Sticky top, directly under fee banner. Glassmorphism. Logo on left (Rocket icon + CoinLaunch), Wallet Connect button on right (Phantom/Solflare branding).
components.hero: Kinetic typography. 'CREATE A SOLANA MEME COIN IN SECONDS. NO CODING.' Masked line reveal. Subtle abstract/rocket background image masked behind text.
components.token_creator_form: Bento-grid card on the page. Deep black surface, 1px subtle border. Inputs: Token Name, Symbol, Image Upload (dashed border dropzone), Next button.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Text: 'FAST • SECURE • NO CODE • AUDITED • COINLAUNCH'. Font: JetBrains Mono, uppercase, text-zinc-700.
components.manifesto_steps: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03) in massive Unbounded font (text-6xl text-zinc-800). Explanation in bright white.
components.faq: Shadcn Accordion. Minimal styling. border-b border-[#1A1A1A]. Questions in Unbounded text-lg, answers in JetBrains Mono text-zinc-400.

hero_background.description: Cinematic orange rocket launch for the hero background, apply heavy black overlay (bg-black/70) so text pops.

abstract_texture.description: Dark abstract tech neon light backdrop. Use as a subtle section divider or blend into the form background.

solana_accent.description: 3D crypto coin render, use in the 'How it works' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use .js extensions for your React components, NOT .tsx.
DO NOT build basic HTML selects or accordions. Use shadcn/ui components but customize them extensively for the dark theme.
DO NOT use standard rounded cards. Go for sharp edges or max 8px (rounded-md).
Never use generic placeholder images, use the provided Unsplash URLs.
Ensure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the sticky header; use backdrop-blur and a semi-transparent hex.
Prioritize optical alignment. Don't center text aimlessly.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor-icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
